name: DIN
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The official X account of AI blockchain project DIN (@din_lol_) has been compromised by a hacker. Current posts from the account are not from the official team, and users are advised not to click any links or engage with related content. Additionally, the X accounts of DIN founder Harold and the DIN Foundation (@Foundation_DIN) have also been hijacked. The DIN team is actively addressing the incident and urges users to rely on official channels for further updates.
